Confirm job-history fields, local export and the method for approved offline updates.

machines.documentedPath: Prusa documents offline setup, slicing, USB printing and offline firmware installation. Local network printing is also documented but is outside the proposed USB workflow.
verifyOnSite: Confirm the site-approved slicer, firmware and removable-media handling.
Confirm which execution data and job identifiers can be captured. Preserve the prepared print file separately from observed execution.
Confirm material compatibility for the use case. This is an offline FFF reference, with no assumed equivalence to the F770 and ABS-M30 route.

machines.documentedPath: Formlabs documents direct USB connection and PreForm job transfer without machine network access. Formlabs lists Dashboard registration in the setup guide and describes Internet access for Dashboard connectivity.
verifyOnSite: Verify whether commissioning can be completed under the site's connectivity policy and what registration or licensing is needed.
Confirm the precise PreForm version, job-upload path and report or log export available in the USB-only workflow.
Check the workstation's network and telemetry settings separately from the printer configuration.

machines.documentedPath: EOSCONNECT Core release notes list the M 290 and describe the on-machine service, OPC UA for live data and events, and the certificate-protected Web API for historical and quality data.
verifyOnSite: Confirm currently supported EOSYSTEM and EOSCONNECT versions, applicable licence and which data interfaces the exact installation exposes.
Verify certificate trust, authentication and a read-only consumer role on the chosen interface. Review OPC UA security settings separately from Web API settings.
Confirm the report's build identifiers and file availability. The data-interface evidence does not cover offline commissioning or job preparation.
